notes: Page states these are Fedders-Airwell serial styles being used for Koppel, adding 'although unconfirmed it is believed that all Fedders-Airwell units use these styles' — that unconfirmed-belief caveat is recorded here and flagged for the coordinator (cf. the Emerson unconfirmed-belief precedent: text-stated rules ship with the caveat on file, not silently). NOTHING is imported from any Fedders page: both shipped styles are transcribed from Koppel's own page text alone. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 3 (month = 1st letter, year = 2nd characters, both chart), page Style 4 (month = 1st letter, year = 2nd characters, both chart), page Style 5 (month = 2nd-to-last letter, year = last letter, both chart) — no text-verified year, so no year-only file for them. Style 2 ships year-only (its month is a chart-only letter).

styles.era: 12-character serials, 2 letters + 9 digits + letter, year + week
styles.notes: Week = 3rd-4th characters [2,4], year = 5th-6th characters [4,6] (1-based converted). The page highlights segment 0201, consistent with week 02 / year 01.

styles.era: 8-character serials, 2 digits + letter + 5 digits, year only
styles.notes: Page example shown as 02J-60002; dash stripped by normalization. Year = 1st-2nd characters [0,2]. Month = 3rd character (letter), chart-only, so year-only.
